notes.title: The Room Three - Coming to Steam November 13th!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that The Room Three is coming to PC via Steam on November 13th! With release less that a month away we'd love you to spread the word and get the game added it to your wishlist!

Since releasing The Room Three on mobile devices back in 2015, one of [i]the most frequent requests[/i] we've received has been to develop it for PC. We've been working hard over the past year to turn this request in to reality!

As with the first two games in the series, The Room Three has received a complete visual overhaul for PC. Every asset and environment has been re-built, re-textured and re-lit to bring the mysterious world of The Room to life

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33770916/0949567c0d2212fc24d51feac38bcc14139fb984.jpg[/img]

We hope you're as excited to play as we are to release!

- Fireproof Games Team
